Container.Name: ac-controller
Container.Overview: AC Controller — bang-bang thermostat that controls your AC unit via Home Assistant. Replaces the Node-RED AC flow with a proper FSM including hysteresis, debounce, anti-short-cycle, and a staleness watchdog. Managed via a web UI with live WebSocket updates.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the AC Controller web interface.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and config.yaml.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance.

Config.Name: Home Assistant Long-Lived Token
Config.Description: Long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile page (Profile → Long-Lived Access Tokens → Create Token).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for schedule evaluation and log timestamps. E.g. Europe/London, America/New_York.
